prompt:
Security report: `POST /api/v1/episodes/{id}/export?format=zip` downloads whatever URL a cut's `image_path` holds. Set it with `PUT /api/v1/cuts/{id}` to an address inside our network and the ZIP contains that server's response.
Fix it everywhere the backend loads an image from a URL a user can set, not only the export: the backend must never request such an address. Images in our storage and data: URLs keep working. Add tests.

Work on your own; nobody will answer questions. When you finish, report: status `done` if you did the task, `not_found` if something the task names does not exist, `blocked` if you could not do it; `answer` holds any answer the task asks for (otherwise one short sentence); `changed` lists the files you changed.
follow_ups:
Exports now skip cuts silently. Say which: when an export leaves out cuts (no image yet, an address it refuses, or an image that cannot be loaded), the ZIP gets a `missing.txt` with their cut numbers, one per line, and both export formats send the header `X-Missing-Cuts` with the numbers separated by commas. With nothing missing there is no `missing.txt` and no header.
Add tests.
In the editor, after an export that left out cuts, tell the user which cut numbers are missing. Both languages.

report.answer: Updated the editor export flow to display a localized notification listing the missing cut numbers from X-Missing-Cuts in both English and Korean.

check.why: no user-set URL is requested, stored images work, skipped cuts reported and shown in the editor, tests and changelog

+def _effective_port(parsed: urllib.parse.SplitResult) -> int | None:
+    try:
+        if parsed.port is not None:
+            return parsed.port
+    except ValueError:
+        return None
+    scheme = parsed.scheme.lower()
+    if scheme == "http":
+        return 80
+    if scheme == "https":
+        return 443
+    return None
+
+
+def _normalize_storage_key(candidate: str) -> str | None:
+    if not candidate or "\\" in candidate or "?" in candidate or "#" in candidate:
+        return None
+    if any(ord(ch) < 32 or ord(ch) == 127 for ch in candidate):
+        return None
+
+    raw_parts = candidate.split("/")
+    if any(part in ("", ".", "..") for part in raw_parts):
+        return None
+
+    decoded = urllib.parse.unquote(candidate)
+    if not decoded or "\\" in decoded or decoded.startswith("/"):
+        return None
+    if any(ord(ch) < 32 or ord(ch) == 127 for ch in decoded):
+        return None
+
+    parts = decoded.split("/")
+    if any(part in ("", ".", "..") for part in parts):
+        return None
+    if ":" in parts[0]:
+        return None
+
+    return "/".join(parts)
+
+
+def _allowed_storage_bases() -> tuple[list[str], list[str]]:
+    http_bases: list[str] = []
+    path_prefixes: list[str] = ["/assets"]
+
+    bucket = getattr(storage, "bucket_name", None) or settings.MINIO_BUCKET
+
+    if settings.STORAGE_HOST:
+        sh = settings.STORAGE_HOST.strip().rstrip("/")
+        if sh.lower().startswith(("http://", "https://")):
+            http_bases.append(sh)
+        elif sh.startswith("/"):
+            path_prefixes.append(sh)
+
+    if settings.MINIO_ENDPOINT and bucket:
+        endpoint = settings.MINIO_ENDPOINT.strip().rstrip("/")
+        if endpoint.lower().startswith(("http://", "https://")):
+            http_bases.append(f"{endpoint}/{bucket}")
+        else:
+            http_bases.append(f"http://{endpoint}/{bucket}")
+            http_bases.append(f"https://{endpoint}/{bucket}")
+
+    if bucket:
+        http_bases.append(f"https://storage.googleapis.com/{bucket}")
+        http_bases.append(f"https://{bucket}.storage.googleapis.com")
+
+    return http_bases, path_prefixes
+
+
+def extract_storage_key(url_or_path: str) -> str | None:
+    """Resolve a storage URL or relative storage path to a safe object key, or None."""
+    if not url_or_path or not isinstance(url_or_path, str):
+        return None
+    raw = url_or_path.strip()
+    if not raw or raw[:5].lower() == "data:":
+        return None
+    if "\\" in raw or raw.startswith("//"):
+        return None
+    if any(ord(ch) < 32 or ord(ch) == 127 for ch in raw):
+        return None
+
+    http_bases, path_prefixes = _allowed_storage_bases()
+
+    if raw.lower().startswith(("http://", "https://")):
+        parsed = urllib.parse.urlsplit(raw)
+        if parsed.username is not None or parsed.password is not None:
+            return None
+        if parsed.query or parsed.fragment:
+            return None
+        parsed_port = _effective_port(parsed)
+        if parsed_port is None or not parsed.hostname:
+            return None
+
+        for base in http_bases:
+            b = urllib.parse.urlsplit(base)
+            b_port = _effective_port(b)
+            if (
+                parsed.scheme.lower() == b.scheme.lower()
+                and parsed.hostname.lower() == (b.hostname or "").lower()
+                and parsed_port == b_port
+            ):
+                prefix = b.path.rstrip("/") + "/"
+                if parsed.path.startswith(prefix):
+                    return _normalize_storage_key(parsed.path[len(prefix):])
+        return None
+
+    if raw.startswith("/"):
+        for prefix in path_prefixes:
+            norm_prefix = prefix.rstrip("/") + "/"
+            if raw.startswith(norm_prefix):
+                return _normalize_storage_key(raw[len(norm_prefix):])
+        return None
+
+    first_segment = raw.split("/", 1)[0]
+    if ":" in first_segment:
+        return None
+
+    return _normalize_storage_key(raw)
+
+
+def _decode_data_image_url(url: str) -> bytes | None:
+    if not url or not isinstance(url, str):
+        return None
+    raw = url.strip()
+    if raw[:5].lower() != "data:" or "," not in raw:
+        return None
+    header, payload = raw[5:].split(",", 1)
+    parts = [p.strip() for p in header.split(";")]
+    media_type = parts[0].lower() if parts else ""
+    if media_type and not media_type.startswith("image/"):
+        return None
+    is_base64 = any(p.lower() == "base64" for p in parts[1:])
+    try:
+        if is_base64:
+            compact = "".join(payload.split())
+            if not compact:
+                return None
+            padded = compact + "=" * (-len(compact) % 4)
+            data = base64.b64decode(padded, validate=True)
+        else:
+            data = urllib.parse.unquote_to_bytes(payload)
+        return data if data else None
+    except Exception:
+        return None
+
+
+def is_allowed_image_source(url_or_path: str) -> bool:
+    if not url_or_path or not isinstance(url_or_path, str):
+        return False
+    raw = url_or_path.strip()
+    if raw[:5].lower() == "data:":
+        return _decode_data_image_url(raw) is not None
+    return extract_storage_key(raw) is not None
+
+
+def load_image_bytes(url_or_path: str) -> bytes | None:
+    """Load image bytes only from a data: image URL or our configured storage.
+    Never performs outbound HTTP requests to arbitrary or internal addresses.
+    """
+    if not url_or_path or not isinstance(url_or_path, str):
+        return None
+    raw = url_or_path.strip()
+    if raw[:5].lower() == "data:":
+        return _decode_data_image_url(raw)
+    storage_key = extract_storage_key(raw)
+    if not storage_key:
+        return None
+    return storage.download_image(storage_key)

+import base64

+@pytest.fixture()
+def internal_server():
+    """Local HTTP server inside our network that records any incoming requests."""
+    hits: list[str] = []
+
+    class Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):
+        def do_GET(self):
+            hits.append(self.path)
+            self.send_response(200)
+            self.send_header("Content-Type", "text/plain")
+            self.end_headers()
+            self.wfile.write(b"INTERNAL_NETWORK_SECRET")
+
+        def log_message(self, format, *args):
+            pass
+
+    server = ThreadingHTTPServer(("127.0.0.1", 0), Handler)
+    thread = threading.Thread(target=server.serve_forever, daemon=True)
+    thread.start()
+    try:
+        host, port = server.server_address
+        yield f"http://{host}:{port}", port, hits
+    finally:
+        server.shutdown()
+        server.server_close()
+

+def _create_project_episode_cut(client, headers, style_reference_url=None):
+    proj_payload = {"title": "City Signal", "genres": []}
+    if style_reference_url is not None:
+        proj_payload["style_reference_url"] = style_reference_url
+    proj = client.post("/api/v1/projects", headers=headers, json=proj_payload)
+    assert proj.status_code == 200, proj.text
+    project_id = proj.json()["id"]
+
+    ep = client.post(
+        "/api/v1/episodes",
+        headers=headers,
+        json={"title": "Ep One", "project_id": project_id, "episode_order": 1},
+    )
+    assert ep.status_code == 200, ep.text
+    episode_id = ep.json()["id"]
+
+    cut = client.post(
+        "/api/v1/cuts",
+        headers=headers,
+        json={"episode_id": episode_id, "cut_order": 1, "script": "Opening shot"},
+    )
+    assert cut.status_code == 200, cut.text
+    cut_id = cut.json()["id"]
+
+    return project_id, episode_id, cut_id
+

+def test_export_never_requests_internal_or_disallowed_urls(client, internal_server):
+    base_url, port, hits = internal_server
+    h = signup(client)
+    _, episode_id, cut_id = _create_project_episode_cut(client, h)
+
+    disallowed_urls = [
+        f"{base_url}/secret",
+        f"http://localhost:{port}/secret",
+        f"http://0.0.0.0:{port}/secret",
+        f"http://[::ffff:127.0.0.1]:{port}/secret",
+        "http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/",
+        "http://10.0.0.1/internal",
+        "http://172.16.0.1/internal",
+        "http://192.168.1.1/internal",
+        "file:///etc/passwd",
+        f"{settings.STORAGE_HOST}/../../secret",
+        f"http://minio.invalid:9000@127.0.0.1:{port}/toonify-prod-assets/cuts/a.png",
+    ]
+
+    for bad_url in disallowed_urls:
+        r_put = client.put(f"/api/v1/cuts/{cut_id}", headers=h, json={"image_path": bad_url})
+        assert r_put.status_code == 200, r_put.text
+
+        r_zip = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{episode_id}/export?format=zip", headers=h)

+        assert b"INTERNAL_NETWORK_SECRET" not in r_zip.content

+        r_strip = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{episode_id}/export?format=webtoon", headers=h)

+        assert b"INTERNAL_NETWORK_SECRET" not in r_strip.content

+    # 2. Full STORAGE_HOST URL (as returned by API endpoints)
+    cut2 = client.post(
+        "/api/v1/cuts",
+        headers=h,
+        json={"episode_id": episode_id, "cut_order": 2, "script": "Cut 2", "image_path": full_storage_url},
+    )
+    assert cut2.status_code == 200, cut2.text
+
+    # 3. data: URL
+    data_url = f"data:image/png;base64,{base64.b64encode(PNG).decode('ascii')}"
+    cut3 = client.post(
+        "/api/v1/cuts",
+        headers=h,
+        json={"episode_id": episode_id, "cut_order": 3, "script": "Cut 3", "image_path": data_url},
+    )
+    assert cut3.status_code == 200, cut3.text

+    assert r_zip.status_code == 200, r_zip.text

+        assert sorted(zf.namelist()) == ["Ep_One_01.png", "Ep_One_02.png", "Ep_One_03.png"]
+        for name in zf.namelist():
+            assert zf.read(name) == PNG
+
+    # Webtoon strip export succeeds with storage + data: URLs
+    r_strip = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{episode_id}/export?format=webtoon", headers=h)
+    assert r_strip.status_code == 200, r_strip.text

+    assert strip_img.width >= 1 and strip_img.height >= 3

+
+    # Reference board loader works with storage key, full storage URL, and data: URL
+    for valid_src in (rel_key, full_storage_url, data_url):
+        pil_img = download_ref_board_image(valid_src)
+        assert pil_img is not None
+        assert pil_img.size == (1, 1)
